newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn and soy values lower.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn and soy values lower.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn and soybean basis values were steady to lower largely in reaction to light demand, while winter wheat basis values were unchanged, grain dealers said.

Sri Lanka is to tender January 3 for 100,000 tonnes of optional origin soft and hard wheat for January and February shipment. Also, the Commodity Credit Corp is to tender January 7 for up to 30,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat for Bosnia. Shipment was for Jan 25-Feb 20.
Cyprus will tender December 30 for 18,000 tonnes of optional origin corn for Jan 15-Feb 10 shipment.
